# Sprint19 Tools

> Privacy-first, browser-based engineering utilities from Sprint19. Every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser: nothing is uploaded, stored, or sent to a server. No tracking, no accounts, no backend.

Sprint19 is a product engineering studio that builds software and automation for startups and operators. These tools are free, ad-free utilities for email authentication, DNS, HTTP, TLS, auth tokens, and configuration parsing. They provide structured interpretation only and do not perform security assessment.

- Site: https://tools.sprint19.com/
- Company: https://sprint19.com
- Company profile: https://profile.sprint19.com/
- Contact: hello@sprint19.com

All 32 tools, organized by category:

## Email & DNS

- [DKIM Record Builder](https://tools.sprint19.com/dkim_builder/): Paste your public key and selector to generate a DKIM DNS TXT record.
- [DKIM Inspector](https://tools.sprint19.com/dkim_inspector/): Paste a DKIM TXT record or signature header to inspect fields, flags, and key status.
- [DMARC Record Builder](https://tools.sprint19.com/dmarc_builder/): Fill in your DMARC policy settings and get a ready-to-publish TXT record with field explanations.
- [DMARC XML Reader](https://tools.sprint19.com/dmarc_reader/): Upload a DMARC aggregate report and get a clear, structured interpretation of authentication results.
- [SPF Record Builder](https://tools.sprint19.com/spf_builder/): Enter your authorized senders and IP ranges to generate a complete SPF TXT record.
- [SPF Analyzer](https://tools.sprint19.com/spf_analyzer/): Paste an SPF record to see mechanism breakdown, lookup count, and configuration warnings.
- [DNS TXT Record Inspector](https://tools.sprint19.com/dns_txt_inspector/): Paste a DNS TXT record to parse key/value pairs. Works with DMARC, SPF, DKIM, and domain verification records.
- [Message Header Analyzer](https://tools.sprint19.com/message_header_analyzer/): Paste message headers for a structured field breakdown, authentication signals, and transfer hop summary.
- [EML Viewer](https://tools.sprint19.com/eml_viewer/): Open or paste EML source to inspect headers, body preview, MIME structure, and attachment hints.
- [IDN Converter](https://tools.sprint19.com/idn_converter/): Convert internationalized domain names between Unicode and punycode formats for DNS-safe use.

## SSL & Certificates

- [OpenSSL CSR Builder](https://tools.sprint19.com/openssl_csr_builder/): Enter your domain and organization details to generate an OpenSSL CSR command with optional SAN support.
- [Let's Encrypt Command Builder](https://tools.sprint19.com/letsencrypt_builder/): Select your web server and domain to generate a ready-to-run Certbot command.
- [HSTS Builder](https://tools.sprint19.com/hsts_builder/): Set max-age, includeSubDomains, and preload to generate a Strict-Transport-Security header.

## Auth & Tokens

- [JWT Decoder](https://tools.sprint19.com/jwt_decoder/): Paste a JWT to decode header, payload, and signature. Decode only, no verification.
- [Basic Auth Header Generator](https://tools.sprint19.com/basic_auth_generator/): Enter a username and password to generate a Base64-encoded Authorization header.
- [OAuth Scope Formatter](https://tools.sprint19.com/oauth_scope_formatter/): Paste an OAuth scope string to get a formatted, readable list of scopes.

## HTTP & Headers

- [CORS Checker](https://tools.sprint19.com/cors_checker/): Paste HTTP response headers to analyze CORS configuration and flag common misconfigurations.
- [HTTP Header Analyzer](https://tools.sprint19.com/http_header_analyzer/): Paste HTTP response headers for a structured breakdown of Cache-Control, CSP, CORS, HSTS, and security headers.
- [CSP Policy Parser](https://tools.sprint19.com/csp_parser/): Paste a Content-Security-Policy header to break it into a structured directives table.
- [Webhook Viewer](https://tools.sprint19.com/webhook_viewer/): Paste a JSON webhook payload for formatted display, structure stats, and event detection.

## Data & Config

- [ENV File Formatter](https://tools.sprint19.com/env_formatter/): Paste a .env file to get a structured table with optional value masking.
- [Redis URL Parser](https://tools.sprint19.com/redis_url_parser/): Paste a Redis connection URL to extract host, port, database, and auth details.
- [Postgres JSON Formatter](https://tools.sprint19.com/postgres_json_formatter/): Paste JSON from psql output. Handles escaped formats, pretty-prints, and validates.
- [Calendar File Viewer](https://tools.sprint19.com/calendar_file_viewer/): Upload or paste ICS calendar content to parse VEVENT entries into a readable event table.

## DevOps & Logs

- [Dockerfile Linter](https://tools.sprint19.com/dockerfile_linter/): Paste a Dockerfile to flag unpinned base images, missing WORKDIR, and multiple RUN layers.
- [NGINX Config Formatter](https://tools.sprint19.com/nginx_formatter/): Paste an NGINX config block to get pretty-printed, readable output.
- [Rails Log Beautifier](https://tools.sprint19.com/rails_log_beautifier/): Paste Rails server logs to group requests, extract stats, and color-code status results.
- [Port Check Command Generator](https://tools.sprint19.com/port_check/): Generate terminal commands for host/port checks with TCP or UDP options. Command snippets only.

## Utilities

- [LinkedIn Text Formatter](https://tools.sprint19.com/linkedin_text_formatter/): Format plain text with Unicode styling for copy/paste into LinkedIn posts and comments.
- [Color Picker & Palette Generator](https://tools.sprint19.com/color_picker/): Generate complementary, analogous, triadic, and monochrome palettes from any base color with WCAG contrast ratios.
- [JavaScript to TypeScript Converter](https://tools.sprint19.com/js_to_ts_converter/): Paste JavaScript code to get a TypeScript version with basic type annotations and interface scaffolding.
- [Encode / Decode](https://tools.sprint19.com/encode_decode/): Encode and decode text as Base64, URL, or HTML entities with deterministic local conversion.
- [Odoo Pricing Calculator](https://tools.sprint19.com/odoo_calculator/): Estimate Odoo subscription costs with a first-year discount, side-by-side plan options, hosting, and offline USD to PHP conversion.
- [Brand Identity Questionnaire](https://tools.sprint19.com/brand_identity/): Client brand discovery questionnaire with shareable link save and print-to-PDF handoff for design intake.

## About Sprint19

Sprint19 builds MLPs, web and mobile apps, AI-assisted products, and automation for startups. Partners on four continents since 2008. Principles behind these tools: clear over clever, deterministic over speculative, minimal infrastructure, transparent logic.
